Basic Information

  • Host Institution: Heriot-Watt University, Dubai Campus
  • School: Mathematical and Computer Sciences
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: Up to 4 years (full-time)
  • Start Date: September, January, May
  • Funding Type: Self-funded
  • Tuition Fees: ~AED 99,500/year
  • Location: Dubai, UAE
  • Contact: Prof. Hani Ragab Hassen (h.ragabhassen@hw.ac.uk)
  • Official Website: https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/research/mathematical-and-computer-sciences

Project Overview & Significance

Heriot-Watt University's Dubai Campus offers a dynamic, self-funded PhD programme in Computer Sciences, situated in one of the world's fastest-growing technology hubs. This programme provides a unique opportunity to conduct high-impact research in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or Cyber Security within a global academic framework. The Dubai government's strategic focus on becoming a leading smart city makes this an ideal location for applied technology research. Students will benefit from the university's international reputation and the local ecosystem of tech startups, corporate hubs, and government innovation initiatives. The research produced here aims to solve complex, real-world problems, from securing critical infrastructure to developing AI-driven analytics for smart cities.

Research Themes & Objectives

The programme covers three primary research areas. 'Data Science' focuses on predictive analytics, big data processing, semantic technologies, and advanced visualisation. 'Artificial Intelligence' encompasses machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and robotics. 'Cyber Security' involves malware detection, network intrusion prevention, and digital forensics. The objective is to develop algorithms and systems that push the boundaries of current technology. Students are encouraged to align their research with the strategic technological needs of the UAE and the broader global tech community.

Training & Development

Students at the Dubai Campus have access to modern research facilities and a diverse, international academic community. The programme fosters close collaboration between students and supervisors, ensuring a supportive research environment. Training includes research methodology, academic publishing, and technical workshops. Graduates will emerge with a globally recognised PhD degree from Heriot-Watt University, positioning them for leadership roles in academia, the tech industry, or government.

Eligibility & Requirements

Applicants must hold a first-class or upper second-class honours degree and a Master's degree in computer science or a closely related discipline. A detailed research proposal of 3-4 pages is required. As this is a self-funded programme, applicants must secure their own funding to cover tuition fees.

How to Apply & Official Contacts

Prospective candidates should prepare a research proposal and contact the Director of Postgraduate Studies, Prof. Hani Ragab Hassen, at h.ragabhassen@hw.ac.uk to discuss their research ideas before formally applying. Applications can be submitted via the Heriot-Watt Dubai application portal. For general campus enquiries, contact dubai-enquiries@hw.ac.uk.
